create_InputBuffers: create pre-allocated GPU input buffers for vLLM request batching with max requests and tokens
create_InputBatch_make_dummy: create a dummy InputBatch for testing with specified number of requests and tokens
build_prepare_prefill_inputs: build prefill input tokens from all_token_ids using idx_mapping and query_start_loc on GPU
build_prepare_pos_seq_lens: build position and sequence length tensors from idx_mapping and num_computed_tokens on GPU
build_combine_sampled_and_draft_tokens: combine sampled and draft tokens into input_ids for speculative decoding and return logits indices
